title: CDC20B Dysregulation: Links to Tumor Prognosis and Immunity.
snippet: This study aimed to clarify the pan-cancer expression pattern, upstream regulatory mechanisms, prognostic relevance, and immune associations of CDC20B. Using public databases (GTEx, GEO, and TCGA), we examined CDC20B expression and its associations with prognosis and tumor immunity across multiple cancers.
